summary: EU-West latency spikes impacting Dedicated tier (p95/p99 regressions on chat + embeddings)
description:
Customer report (via Enterprise Support): Lattice Health’s Dedicated deployment in EU-West is seeing intermittent latency spikes starting ~2026-02-03 08:40 UTC.

Impacted endpoints:
- /v1/chat/completions (streaming + non-streaming)
- /v1/embeddings

Customer-reported symptoms:
- p95 chat latency jumping from ~900–1200ms to 4–7s for 10–20 minute intervals
- p99 > 12s during worst windows
- No sustained 5xx increase, but elevated client-side timeouts due to long tail latency

Business impact:
- Production clinician note summarization flow timing out (customer says they have a 10s overall timeout in their app)
- They are concerned this violates Dedicated latency commitments and asked for an SLO view + explanation of how it’s computed.

Initial scope/notes:
- Region: eu-west only (customer confirms us-east Dedicated looks normal)
- Models: rw-llama-70b-instruct and rw-embed-v3 (both used in same workflow)
- Tier: Dedicated (reserved capacity). Confirm tier tags present on request context.

Requested from customer:
- Example request IDs and timestamps (UTC)
- Confirmation if requests were hitting fallback models
- Any correlation to customer-side deploys

Internal triage checklist:
- Validate Dedicated tier SLO dashboards in EU-West for customer account
- Check GPU pool headroom + queue depth
- Check routing policy changes and canaries in last 24h
- Verify no noisy-neighbor spillover from Hosted in EU-West

Slack context:
- #support thread: sources/slack/support/1770907714.json
- #eng-infra thread (capacity): sources/slack/eng-infra/1770669135.json
comments: 2026-02-03 09:12 UTC — Rachel Kim (Reporter): Customer reports started 08:40 UTC. Requested 10 example request IDs + timestamps and whether streaming disconnects occurred. Customer says mostly timeouts; no obvious disconnects.

2026-02-03 09:20 UTC — Markus Klein (Solutions Engineering): Confirmed customer’s org is on Dedicated pool eu-west-ded-07. They are pinned to rw-llama-70b-instruct@2026-01-30 and rw-embed-v3@2026-01-15. No customer-side deploy reported this morning.

2026-02-03 09:34 UTC — Aisha Bello (Assignee): Pulled tiered SLO dashboard (Dedicated > EU-West > Chat/Completions). p95 and p99 elevated starting ~08:45 UTC; success rate stable. This looks like saturation / queueing rather than error spikes. Adding annotation for investigation start. Linking runbook: error-budget-breach-mitigation-runbook.

2026-02-03 09:41 UTC — Neha Kapoor (cc via on-call): Please confirm whether this is isolated to one Dedicated pool or region-wide EU-West Dedicated. If budget burn crosses fast window thresholds, treat as incident per new process (even if customer only).

2026-02-03 09:49 UTC — Peter Holtz (Overload/failover SRE): GPU queue depth on eu-west-ded-07 spiked. Headroom dipped below target during burst. Not seeing kernel errors. Suspect autoscaling lag + batcher config too aggressive for this traffic mix (more long prompts than baseline).

2026-02-03 10:02 UTC — Aisha Bello: Checked routing/control-plane changes: no policy change in last 24h for this account. However, EU-West Hosted traffic also elevated due to a marketing event; possible shared infra contention at gateway layer or network egress. Need to confirm Dedicated isolation boundaries. Looping Mina Haddad (Routing) + Neha’s infra on-call.

2026-02-03 10:18 UTC — Mina Haddad (Routing): Verified tier tags are correct at ingress for this account. No cross-tier fallback to Hosted for Dedicated. Dedicated requests remained within dedicated pool, but shared API gateway in eu-west showed elevated CPU. Suggest temporarily shifting this account to dedicated gateway slice if available.
2026-02-03 10:31 UTC — Ethan Park (Control Plane): Confirmed no control-plane policy evaluation latency issues (p99 < 25ms). The spikes are downstream (serving queue + gateway).

2026-02-03 10:44 UTC — Neha Kapoor: Approving mitigation: (1) add capacity to eu-west-ded-07, (2) reduce max batch for chat route for this account until headroom stabilizes, (3) if needed, move to eu-west-ded-09 pool with more free GPUs. Capture changes as annotations on SLO dashboard.

2026-02-03 11:05 UTC — Sergio Costa (Dashboards/alerts): Added customer-specific filter to Dedicated tier SLO dashboard and shared internal link. Also confirmed burn-rate alert fired (fast window) for Dedicated EU-West Chat latency SLO; incident bot posted summary in #eng-sre.

2026-02-03 11:22 UTC — Aisha Bello: Mitigation applied: reduced max_batch_tokens for rw-llama-70b-instruct in this pool, and adjusted continuous batching aggressiveness for the chat endpoint. Latency improving within 5–10 minutes; watching tail.

2026-02-03 11:40 UTC — Infra on-call (via Aisha): Added 8x GPUs to eu-west-ded-07 (capacity add completed). Queue depth down; p95 normalized. Remaining p99 spikes likely from warm KV cache misses after the burst subsided.

2026-02-03 12:06 UTC — Rachel Kim: Updated customer: we identified regional saturation in the Dedicated pool during burst; added capacity and tuned batching. Asked them to re-test and share any remaining request IDs. Also informed them we can provide an SLO view in Console (Dedicated Reliability) once access is provisioned.

2026-02-03 15:18 UTC — Customer (via Rachel): Confirmed improvements; p95 back to ~1.1s. They still see occasional p99 ~9–10s but less frequent. Requesting ongoing visibility and whether these events count against their SLA.

2026-02-03 16:00 UTC — Aisha Bello: p99 still elevated during short bursts; suggests autoscaling reaction time + burst buffering. Proposed follow-up: reserve additional headroom in EU-West Dedicated pools and set tighter alerting for pool headroom before SLO impact. Linking capacity mitigation guidelines page.

2026-02-04 09:10 UTC — Logan Wright (Telemetry): Confirmed the new tiered SLO dashboards are correctly attributing to Dedicated and not mixing Hosted. No cardinality issues observed after enabling account-level view for this customer (uses hashed account id label).

2026-02-04 10:27 UTC — Rachel Kim: Customer asked how retries/fallback affect SLO. Replied with summary: latency SLI is end-to-end from gateway receive to final token (or response end), and Dedicated does not fallback to Hosted; retries are accounted per request attempt; client aborts excluded only when we can attribute a client-side cancel (per SLI standard).

2026-02-05 13:42 UTC — Aisha Bello: Implemented preventative change: pre-scale threshold lowered for eu-west-ded pools, plus a temporary headroom target increase for business hours. No further fast-window burn since 2026-02-03. Marking incident mitigated; leaving ticket open until CS confirms SLO reporting access delivered.

2026-02-06 08:55 UTC — Rachel Kim: Access to Dedicated SLO dashboard granted to CS/SE via INT-9331; we can share screenshots/exports in customer QBR. Customer confirms stable latency past 48h. Closing as resolved with follow-ups tracked separately.
resolution:
Root cause: saturation/queueing in EU-West Dedicated pool (eu-west-ded-07) during burst traffic, compounded by autoscaling lag and overly aggressive batching settings for the customer’s prompt/sequence length mix. Secondary contributor: shared EU-West API gateway CPU pressure coincident with elevated regional load (no evidence of cross-tier request mixing, but gateway contention increased end-to-end tail).

Mitigations applied:
- Added GPU capacity to eu-west-ded-07 (+8 GPUs) and temporarily increased headroom targets during EU business hours.
- Tuned batching parameters for chat route in the pool to reduce tail latency under burst.
- Added dashboard annotations for capacity and config changes; monitored Dedicated tier burn-rate alert until clear.

Customer comms:
- Provided explanation of SLI boundaries (end-to-end latency; Dedicated does not fallback to Hosted; client abort handling per SLI spec).
- Provided path to Dedicated tier SLO dashboards (shared internally and via CS/SE) and committed to include SLO reporting in customer check-ins.

Follow-ups (not blocking closure):
- Improve proactive headroom alerting for EU-West Dedicated pools.
- Evaluate dedicated gateway slice / stronger isolation for EU-West.
- Ensure Dedicated customer-facing SLO exports are available in Console workflow.
